definitions.accent: gesture peak velocity >= 90% of bar peak, excluding chucks
definitions.alignment: actual kick or non-ghost snare within 0.1 quarter-note beat
definitions.near_miss: off-quarter accent within 0.1-0.3 beats of drum attack but not aligned; compare in 4/4 only
definitions.device_bar: at least one comp_fill or comp_stop event
definitions.tail_bar: at least one rsingle event, not automatically a variation
definitions.figure_bars: membership in the two most common onset/technique bars of each section occurrence
definitions.silent_beats: bar duration minus union of sounding guitar note intervals
definitions.clash: cross-part minor second or tritone overlap >=0.5 beat; candidate, not a verdict
